source.relative_path: 2018美赛特等奖/E题7篇/E74971-Climate counts! Less Fragility & better Countries.pdf

source_quality.notes: text layer covers all 23 pages; the piecewise index, the normal density, the forecast line and the cost equation were read from the raster

task_reconstruction: Build a climate change index from anomalies, build a fragility index from twelve indicators, couple the two with an exponential, forecast the year a country crosses a danger line, and price the interventions.

section_map.summary: the attached attention and the borrowed definition
the four ranks and their boundaries
the tipping points and the forecast
the sensitivity and the owned weaknesses

contributions.summary: a three piece index that rises fast for a small anomaly and then slows
a fragility index stacked from an entropy weighting and a variation weighting
an exponential coupling between the climate index and the fragility index
a danger line for each aspect rather than one line for the total

dependency_graph.relation: the three indicators are what the climate index averages
the entropy weights build the three group indexes
the climate index is the input of the exponential
the fragility index is what the exponential fits
the yearly climate index is the series projected forward

assumptions.summary: a country is one unit, so regional climate differences are dropped
every country acts, and the passive countries are set aside
the four climate factors are equally important
without climate change the fragility is small and constant

data_and_preprocessing.summary: indicators split into cost type and gain type and standardized in opposite directions
twenty countries chosen to vary in location, economy and climate

verification.summary: six countries set against a published ranking
temperature and rainfall checked against a normal curve
a second fit crosses the line within two to four years of the first

results_trace.summary: the coupling is 21.25 times an exponential with rate 0.0636
the index is forecast to cross in 2023

writing_logic.summary: a conclusion is said to come to the authors
equal weights are justified by the difficulty of measuring them
a weak fit is owned and then excused
a threshold is delivered as a call to stay watchful

language_observations.summary: opens with considerable attention has been attached
narrates a curve as slowing from linear to logarithmic
reports a fit as not perfect and still vital
says the index will boom and exceed the line

visualization_observations.summary: the four ranks are drawn as colored bands with their boundaries
the new index is set beside a published ranking
the forecast is drawn crossing a marked danger line
the second fit is drawn inside a confidence band

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: reporting a fit of 0.5317 and calling it not perfect reads as honest about a weak model
owning the national average and the excluded countries as weaknesses reads as candour

weaknesses.summary: the group weights come from a scrambled table
the prose names Kenya where the section studies Mexico
the total cost and the opportunity cost share one symbol
the tipping point is said to be reached when the index drops, against the rising curve

independent_extensions.summary: score an anomaly with a curve that rises fast inside one standard deviation and then slows
give each component its own danger line and tell the reader to stay watchful when any one is crossed

unresolved_questions: the smoothing recurrence is named but never printed
the group weights are read from a scrambled table
the total cost and the opportunity cost share the symbol TC
the tipping point is described as a drop while the fitted curve rises
